blocks.text: The holiday season is just around the corner, and there’s no better time to start checking off your Christmas gift list! Whether you’re shopping for your loved ones or treating yourself to an upgrade, Anker Philippines is making the season brighter with exciting 11.11 deals across Anker Charging, Anker soundcore and Anker eufy.

Under its The More, The Merrier with Anker campaign, shoppers can enjoy up to 20% OFF on select products, plus exclusive freebies and special bundle offers. From everyday charging essentials and immersive audio companions to smart home innovations, discover thoughtful tech gifts that bring more convenience, entertainment, and joy to every celebration.
Give the Gift of Power with Anker Charging

Make sure your loved ones never run out of power this holiday season with Anker’s innovative charging essentials. Whether it’s for someone always on-the-go or a gadget enthusiast who needs reliable everyday charging, Anker has the perfect gift.
This 11.11, enjoy special discounts on the Anker Nano Charger and Anker MagGo Power Bank 2 Pro.

Small yet powerful, the Anker Nano Charger is more than just an everyday charging essential. Featuring an intelligent display that can identify your iPhone and deliver a more personalized charging experience, it combines smart technology with compact convenience. Get yours for only PHP1,195, down from its original SRP of PHP1,995, and enjoy smarter charging this Christmas.

For those constantly on the move, the Anker MagGo Power Bank 2 Pro keeps your devices powered throughout the day while its advanced cooling technology helps manage heat for a cooler, more comfortable charging experience. Get yours for only PHP5,995 and enjoy reliable power wherever the holiday takes you.
Make your Christmas shopping even more rewarding! Shoppers can also get an Anker Nano Charger (20W) plus additional discounts when purchasing select Anker Charging products.
Make Christmas More Musical with Anker soundcore

Give the gift of great sound this Christmas with Anker soundcore. From immersive listening experiences to comfortable audio companions for active lifestyles, Anker soundcore makes every playlist, workout and everyday moment more enjoyable.
This 11.11, enjoy exclusive deals on the Anker soundcore Liberty 5 Pro Series and AeroClip 2.

For music lovers who appreciate premium sound and uninterrupted listening, the Anker soundcore Liberty 5 Pro delivers an immersive audio experience with Active Noise Cancellation, now available for only PHP8,995, down from PHP9,995. For those looking for an upgraded experience, the Anker soundcore Liberty 5 Pro Max offers premium audio with the added convenience of an integrated display screen, now yours for only PHP10,995, from its original SRP of PHP12,995. Give the gift of exceptional sound this Christmas!

Looking for something different? The Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 features an open-ear design that lets you enjoy your favorite music while staying connected to your surroundings. With clear call quality, you can stay connected and take calls with confidence without missing what’s happening around you. Get yours for only PHP9,995 and receive a FREE Sports Backpack with every purchase. It’s the perfect gift for those who love music and an active lifestyle.
Shoppers can also enjoy an Anker product plus additional discounts on select Anker soundcore products, making it easier to give more this Christmas.
Give the Gift of More Free Time with Anker eufy

This Christmas, give your loved ones something they’ll appreciate everyday, more time for themselves. With Anker eufy’s smart home cleaning solutions, keeping a home clean and comfortable becomes easier and more convenient.
Make everyday cleaning smarter with the Anker eufy Robot Vacuum 3-in-1 E20, now available for only PHP15,995, down from its original SRP of PHP18,995 plus Dust bag.

For an even more convenient cleaning experience, the Anker eufy Robot Vacuum Omni C20 is now priced at PHP17,995, from PHP19,995. As an added Christmas treat, every Omni C20 purchase comes with a FREE accessory bundle including: 2 packs of Omni C20 mop cloths, 2 packs of washable filters, 1 rolling brush, 1 brush guard with comb and 1 birdy knife.
Shoppers can also enjoy an Anker product plus additional discounts on select Anker eufy products, making it easier to give the gift of a smarter, more convenient home this holiday season.
Shop the 11.11 Deals Across Your Favorite E-Commerce Platforms

The Christmas shopping season starts now! Enjoy Anker’s exciting 11.11 deals through its official stores across the country’s leading e-commerce platforms. But don’t wait too long, each platform has its own sale period.
Make Your Christmas Shopping More Rewarding with Anker

The best gifts are those that make everyday life better. Whether you’re helping someone stay powered up, making their favorite music sound even better, or giving them more time to enjoy the holidays, Anker offers thoughtful tech essentials for everyone on your Christmas list.
Don’t miss the opportunity to enjoy up to 20% OFF on select products, exclusive freebies and special bundle deals this 11.11!
Start your Christmas shopping early and Power Up Your Christmas with Anker.
